warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4-5-6-6'-7 at 3.10 + 1.90 + 0.80 + 0.80 + 2.00 + 0.40 + 0.60 (9.60); y = A-A'-B-B'-C-D-E-F-G at 0.60 + 1.90 + 0.80 + 0.30 + 1.50 + 1.20 + 2.70 + 0.80 (9.80). Origin A1. The same chains are printed on S-01, S-02, S-03 and S-04, and again on the building sections A-07 (x) and A-08 (y). Vector CAD PDF with no text layer -- every value read off the rendered page.
6', A' and B' are printed in their own grid bubbles on every structural plan, so they are NAMED lines (type named), not dummies. Footings/columns stand on them (A'6, B'6').

x dummies: 1'' (1.00) is the 1.00 + 2.10 tick printed on S-01/S-02/S-03 -- a real line (footing F2 + column C1 at G1'', beam E1''-G1''). 1' (-1.00), 1''' (2.10), 4' (6.00), 5' (7.60) and 7' (10.00) come from the S-04 roof-frame chains (roof edges and อกไก่ ends). The before-origin 1' shares the grid-1 prime sequence with 1'' and 1''' (section 4).

y dummies: A'' (1.50), A''' (2.30), E' (7.30), G' (10.00), G'' (10.80) and the two before-origin ticks (-1.00, -0.40) all come from the S-04 roof-frame chains (roof edges / rafter ends). Naming: see dummy_grid_rule_check -- the before-origin pair cannot take A'/A'' because A' is a printed bubble, so they are A'''' and A''''' (next free primes on A, same rule tools/gridfix.py applies), deliberately out of reading order; check_format reports that as a NOTE.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับดินถม (A-07/A-08). Nine different อกไก่ levels are all printed with the same label ระดับหลังอกไก่ on S-04, so z_levels repeats that id with nine values (one per row, see each note); no z chain references them. ระดับดินเดิม (S-05) and ระดับดิน (S-07) print no value -- kept with level_m null.
The ดั้ง post at about 7.28 m on row F (S-03, ⊕ symbol) has no printed dimension, so no line was made for it; it is referenced approximately (~F5') in the S-03 file.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-07 plus the building sections A-07 and A-08 (for levels). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations, A-09 sanitary, A-10/A-11 door-window details, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05..S-07 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, pile spacing, section sizes, slab thickness, L/3 / L/4 bar lengths, stair treads/risers), which stay on their elements.
